title: $M^3$: A Multi-LLM System for Multi-Turn Jailbreaking as a Markov Decision Process
abstract: arXiv:2610.31937v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to carefully orchestrated multi-turn interactions that progressively bypass safety mechanisms. However, many existing red-teaming approaches rely on heuristics or impose strong assumptions that limit their applicability in fully black box settings. We address this gap by introducing $M^3$, an automated red-teaming framework that formalizes multi-turn jailbreaking as a finite-horizon Markov Decision Process (MDP). In $M^3$, an attacker LLM interacts with a target LLM while operating over a compact internal state produced by a state LLM. Across two benchmarks and six target models, $M^3$ consistently outperforms state-of-the-art multi-turn red-teaming methods in Attack Success Rates (ASR), achieving improvements of up to 53% in ASR@5. Even with lightweight attacker, $M^3$ attains gains up to 26% in ASR@1 and 34% in ASR@5, compared to baselines that use higher capacity attackers. Beyond

translated_title: $M^3$：一个将多轮越狱形式化为马尔可夫决策过程的多LLM系统
translated_abstract: 现代大型语言模型（LLM）仍然容易受到精心编排的多轮交互攻击，这些交互会逐步绕过其安全机制。然而，许多现有的红队测试方法依赖于启发式方法或施加了较强的假设，限制了它们在完全黑盒设置中的适用性。我们通过引入 $M^3$ 来弥补这一空白，这是一个自动化红队测试框架，将多轮越狱形式化为有限视野的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）。在 $M^3$ 中，攻击者 LLM 与目标 LLM 进行交互，同时在一个由状态 LLM 生成的紧凑内部状态上进行操作。在两个基准测试和六个目标模型上，$M^3$ 在攻击成功率（ASR）方面始终优于最先进的多轮红队测试方法，在 ASR@5 上实现了高达 53% 的提升。即使使用轻量级攻击者，与使用更高能力攻击者的基线相比，$M^3$ 在 ASR@1 上仍可获得高达 26% 的提升，在 ASR@5 上提升高达 34%。
tldr: 该论文提出 $M^3$ 自动化红队测试框架，将多轮越狱形式化为有限视野马尔可夫决策过程，通过攻击者LLM与状态LLM的协作，在完全黑盒设置下显著超越现有方法，攻击成功率最高提升53%。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces $M^3$, an automated red-teaming framework that formalizes multi-turn jailbreaking as a finite-horizon Markov Decision Process, leveraging an attacker LLM and a state LLM to consistently outperform state-of-the-art methods with up to 53% improvement in attack success rate in fully black-box settings.
